newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragonair share listing still undecided.
newsitem.headline: Dragonair share listing still undecided.

text.p: No date has been fixed for Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair) to seek a listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange, chief operating officer Stanley Hui said.

"The shareholders have not decided on a timetable for that. That's the position and until that happens I'm not sure there's more I can say about it," the newly appointed head of Dragonair told reporters.
"There's no question of a delay because the shareholders never set a deadline, so delay does not arise as far as I see it," Hui added.

Speculation has been rife on when the potential share offer might be made since the airline became Chinese- controlled last year. China National Aviation Corporation (CNAC) acquired nearly 36 percent of Dragonair from CITIC, Swire, Cathay and the Chao family.
Dragonair had already announced that it was postponing listing for at least a year due to slow earnings growth.

Aviation analysts said it was hard to assess the airline's share value because it did not disclose earnings figures. But because of China's increased stake, which is seen as enhancing Dragonair's future prospects and profits, analysts said a share listing was expected to interest investors.
